# Research report 1 of 2


## 1. Resolution source
- The governing body's official result (premierleague.com) decides it, with Flashscore and then Sofascore as fallbacks. No result was available as of the cutoff.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing before 17 October settles the question. The match had not been played.

## 3. Recent news (newest first, up to the cutoff)
- 2026-10-11: Alonso praised Caicedo, who made his first start of the season after a calf problem. Reuters said Chelsea had now gone 23 straight Premier League games without a clean sheet. [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/football/2026/10/11/soccer-alonso-hails-caicedos-impact-as-chelsea-crush-bournemouth)
- 2026-10-10: Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1 at home. Henderson scored twice and João Pedro also scored. Chelsea moved to 5th (one source says 4th, on 10 points). [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/chelsea-vs-bmouth/report/559496), [Africa Soccer](https://africasoccer.com/?p=634246)
- 2026-09-18: Brentford beat Chelsea 3-0, Chelsea's third league game in a row without a win. Chelsea had conceded at least twice in all five league games under Alonso, and João Pedro had a knee injury at the time. [Radio X](https://www.radiox.co.uk/news/sport/brentford-3-0-chelsea-defensive-issues-for-xa/), [NST](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/sports/football/2026/09/1535830/brentford-batter-chelsea-undo-alonsos-promising-start)
- Context: Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's new manager after a 10th-place finish last season, and Chelsea are not in the Champions League. Tottenham, under Roberto De Zerbi, went into mid-October without a league win this season and at or near the bottom of the table. [Hayters](https://hayters.com/chelsea-fixture-list-in-full-with-derby-first-up-for-new-boss-xabi-alonso/), [Sky Sports](https://skysports.com/football/news/11095/13555669/chelsea-premier-league-2026-27-fixtures-and-schedule)
- Team news: one preview reports Chelsea's first-choice goalkeeper has a broken jaw, so Penders would start in goal, and that Reece James, Malo Gusto and Chavarria are out. - Football365 says Chelsea are on a six-game Premier League winning streak against Tottenham. [Football365](https://www.football365.com/match-preview/chelsea-v-tottenham-prediction-preview-2026-27)
- Home favourites priced around 4/6 (about 58-60% implied) win roughly 55-60% of the time over 90 minutes.
- Chelsea's league form this season is mixed: roughly 3 wins in 7, and a leaky defence.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

Before 17 October 2026, Chelsea were clearly the stronger side going into this match. They host Tottenham, who had not won a league game all season. I found no betting odds or prediction market prices dated on or before 17 October.

## 1. Resolution source
- Listed kickoff times disagree: 17:30 BST, 15:00 BST or 16:30 GMT. [Vavel](https://www.vavel.com/en/data/chelsea-fc/fixtures/), [mabumbe](https://mabumbe.com/allsports/football-match/1557439/match-details/)
- The result is decided by the official Premier League result, then Flashscore, then Sofascore. Only the 90 minutes plus stoppage time count, so a draw resolves "No".

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-17 the match had not been played and nothing settles the question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-17: Chelsea won 2-0 at Everton, with Pedro Neto scoring twice. It was their first away league win under manager Xabi Alonso. Goalkeeper Emi Martínez had a head injury and the concern is concussion, which could keep him out for about 14 days, including this match. Malo Gusto missed the game through illness. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/match/_/gameId/401878771/chelsea-everton), [Chelsea FC video](https://www.chelseafc.com/en/video/alonso-post-everton-0-2-chelsea-premier-league-2026-27?ssoc=1)
- 2026-10-10: Chelsea beat Bournemouth 5-1 at home. Henderson and João Pedro scored two each, and João Pedro now has 5 for the season. The win ended a four-match winless league run and moved Chelsea to 5th. [Vavel](https://www.vavel.com/en/football/2026/10/10/premier-league/1274721-chelsea-5-1-bournemouth-the-blues-cruise-past-the-cherries.html), [Citizen Digital](https://citizen.digital/article/chelsea-crush-bournemouth-to-end-four-match-winless-run-n391811)
- 2026-10-10: Manchester United 1-1 Tottenham. Bentancur was sent off for a headbutt on Luke Shaw. I did not confirm his ban, but a violent-conduct red card usually brings a three-match suspension, so he would likely miss this game. Spurs were still winless (3 draws, 3 losses, 3 points from 6 games), third from bottom. Manager Roberto De Zerbi was among the bookmakers' favourites to be the next manager sacked. [Tribune/AFP](https://tribune.com.pk/story/2634206/spurs-rescue-draw-at-manchester-united), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/401878773)
- Late Sept 2026: Spurs had their worst start to a Premier League season, including four goalless games. Liverpool knocked them out of the League Cup. Spurs chief executive Venkatesham publicly backed De Zerbi. [theScore](https://www.thescore.com/news/3588190/big-spending-spurs-off-to-historically-bad-start-after-loss-vs-newcastle), [SoccerNews](https://www.soccernews.com/tottenham-chief-venkatesham-backs-de-zerbi-to-turn-things-around/406013/)
- Season context: Chelsea opened with a 3-2 win at Fulham, and their heaviest defeat was 3-0 at Brentford. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49716094/xabi-alonso-wins-chelsea-debut-revamped-front-three-dazzles)

## 4. Base rates
- Chelsea's home record against Spurs is historically very strong. Tottenham's only league win at Stamford Bridge between 1990 and this season was in April 2018. I could not open the rivalry page to confirm the exact numbers. [Wikipedia rivalry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chelsea_F.C.%E2%80%93Tottenham_Hotspur_F.C._rivalry)
- In the Premier League, home teams generally win about 45% of matches. Strong favourites at roughly 1.6-1.8 decimal odds win about 55-60% of the time, and draws happen about 25% of the time. These are general figures, not sourced to this match.
- Chelsea's league form up to 17 October was uneven: the four-game winless run, then two wins in a row.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices dated on or before 2026-10-17.
- Bookmaker previews (Rotowire, Oddschecker, Sportytrader, Racing Post) were published after the cutoff, so I left them out.

- Tottenham play Coventry on Monday 19 October, which leaves them less rest before this match. That game could also end their winless run or add to the pressure on De Zerbi.
- Things to watch:
  - whether Martínez is cleared after the concussion protocol
  - whether Gusto recovers from illness
  - whether Bentancur's suspension is confirmed
  - any change of manager at Spurs
  - confirmation of the kickoff time
